inputText: This is Final Nun — NOON so-FEET. Sound: same N sound as Nun, used only at the end of a word. Shape hook: long icicle below the floor. Tip: Much longer descender than Vav or Zayin, without a base foot; do not mix it up with Vav, Zayin, Final Kaf.
